sourceAssessment: The exact base-relative change consists of eight declared files. Runtime/Python production code is additive: an explicit feature, actual-parent factory and distinct new type. Existing scalar method implementations, public backend registrations, default Python feature configuration and WASM source are unchanged.

Runtime issuance calls the actual Core presence factory on the retained ApplicationLineage object and retains Arc ownership of that same original. is_from uses Arc::ptr_eq, so equal source bytes do not substitute another original. Private fields, no serde/clone constructor and a private scoped consumer prevent importing success data or exporting the borrowed Core context.

Each runtime native-request/lower/check operation re-derives the Core presence context from the retained immutable original and compares the exact issued preparation JSON before dispatch. This does not accept a replacement SQL/AST/context/report. The inherited Core preparation reads its own retained original source data; no claim is made that it performs zero internal JSON parsing.

The native Python class retains the actual Python parent plus the runtime child. Every new method checks their pointer custody. source_preparation returns that actual parent. Frozen non-subclassable native instances have no constructor, mutable instance fields, instance dictionary, copy/pickle reconstruction or class substitution.

Binding/frame entrypoints require exact native builtin PyString objects before length/extraction. No user __str__, __len__ or spoofed __class__ callback runs. Conversion rejects surrogate-containing Python strings; raw UTF8 byte bounds are 4,000,000 and 16,000,000. Exact-size valid inputs pass and size-plus-one inputs refuse.

Old/new raw method descriptors reject the wrong actual class. Old designation/factory paths still refuse .4. Legacy wheels expose neither the new class nor factory. Enabling the runtime feature alone does not expose the Python class/factory.

The bridge exposes compiler/data reports only, with authority:false, securityReady:false and nativeAdmission:required. The invalid selected-occurrence control intentionally still matches structural transport, demonstrating that whole UMF semantic/source/current-cut validation remains a separate required host barrier.

Errors remain scoped fixed messages without supplied private sentinel values or partial success. The contract correctly distinguishes lowering failure from later checking failure: a later refusal cannot erase previously issued SQL; the host must release nothing and clean up its owned stage.
